# AccessModifierPresented

<Badge type="info" text="info" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" />

Group: [Code style](/rules/#code-style) · PhpStorm name: `AccessModifierPresentedInspection`

Class members that rely on PHP's implicit public visibility (methods declared
with no visibility keyword, properties declared with `var`/`static`/`readonly`
only, constants declared with a bare `const`) should spell out their visibility
explicitly so intent is clear to readers.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{5,6,7,11,12,18,23} [Before]
<?php

class Invoice
{
    var $total;
    static $registry = [];
    readonly int $number;
    protected $lines;
    private(set) string $currency;

    function render() {}
    final static function make() {}
    public function save() {}
}

abstract class Shape
{
    abstract function area();
}

interface Printable
{
    function printOut();
}
```

```php [After fix]
<?php

class Invoice
{
    public $total;
    public static $registry = [];
    public readonly int $number;
    protected $lines;
    private(set) string $currency;

    public function render() {}
    final public static function make() {}
    public function save() {}
}

abstract class Shape
{
    abstract public function area();
}

interface Printable
{
    public function printOut();
}
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 5: Declare the visibility of &#39;total&#39; explicitly.</li>
<li>line 6: Declare the visibility of &#39;registry&#39; explicitly.</li>
<li>line 7: Declare the visibility of &#39;number&#39; explicitly.</li>
<li>line 11: Declare the visibility of &#39;render&#39; explicitly.</li>
<li>line 12: Declare the visibility of &#39;make&#39; explicitly.</li>
<li>line 18: Declare the visibility of &#39;area&#39; explicitly.</li>
<li>line 23: Declare the visibility of &#39;printOut&#39; explicitly.</li>
</ul>

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| ANALYZE_INTERFACES | bool | true | When false, interface declarations are not inspected at all. |
| ANALYZE_CONSTANTS | bool | true | When false, class constants are never reported (D3 disabled). |

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "AccessModifierPresented": {
      "enabled": false,
      "options": {
        "ANALYZE_INTERFACES": true,
        "ANALYZE_CONSTANTS": true
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore AccessModifierPresented

/**
 * @noinspection AccessModifierPresentedInspection
 */
```
